validated_boundaries: Acceptance prepare and final transaction re-read active principal, every registered ancestor, final existing root; finalization rejects revoked root and missing child grant without ancestor grant inheritance.

Historical direct principals with no registered lineage retain compatibility; registered chains require every principal/identity row, consistent root, no cycle, depth <=256. Managed child anchor rejects missing child identity and active root substitution.
Managed lineage anchor content hash/principal/project/root checked; same principal+same key host anchor cannot poison v2 command receipt lookup; immutable update trigger enforced.

Actual Host, actual Mu/AppContainer and actual candidate verifier executable with synthetic SSE reject root revocation before acceptance, before qualification, after AVAILABLE before purpose, and after existing purpose before admission.
Old reviewer root-revocation, child-revocation and unknown-policy-drift counterexamples copied byte-for-byte and independently pass on repair candidate.
Original receipts and UNKNOWN money:null/reservation_id:null retained; no new run/dispatch after revoked authority; verifier child token revoked on all tested finishes; no failed qualification retry.
UNKNOWN qualification needs original completed dispatch observation plus current whole unlimited budget ancestry; incomplete UNKNOWN no retry and old RESERVE regressions pass.
Owner-bound session/configuration and frozen runtime/task/plan/profile refs checked; one-call tool-free qualification and durable request consumption retained.
limits: SOURCE + local synthetic fixtures only: no actual Ollama/provider qualification, no protected holdout, no formal or parent acceptance.
Privileged Desktop producer/lifecycle integration remains OPEN. Component is controlled startup flags --runtime-qualification-request and --runtime-verifier-manifest; no renderer/public RPC added.

Managed request loader requires absolute nonredirect regular bounded file and rejects unknown fields/trailing JSON. Standard JSON decoding accepts duplicate keys; request has no expires_at or issued_at. PurposeSeconds is authorization duration, not request freshness. Future confirmation producer needs authoritative atomic expiry contract and duplicate-key policy.

Verifier manifest SourceCommit is declared provenance. This review independently matched both real binaries to candidate Go vcs.revision and vcs.modified=false; installed-producer provenance still requires explicit binding.

Startup concurrently runs ordinary coordinator.Serve/Scan. scanMu+active project/executor+RunAdmitted CAS prevent same-executor double claim; other routes and later READY tasks may run. max_calls=1 is per qualification Run, not a global startup request limit. A single actual provider qualification needs isolated normal data root, no unrelated runnable tasks, and whole-process call observation.

Managed idempotency anchor is protected by immutable-update trigger and registered lineage by immutable/durable identity triggers. Corruption tests deliberately disabled identity guards only inside disposable fixtures; this does not certify arbitrary database-writer isolation.
